paper_title: First results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis (canonical AxionPhoton coupling)
notes: Paper presents first results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment. The experiment probed three mass ranges: 40.9–43.3 neV/c², 49.3–50.6 neV/c², and 54.4–56.7 neV/c². The average sensitivity achieved is g_agamma ≤ 1.9 × 10^-8 GeV^-1 at 95% confidence level. The three data points represent the central mass of each probed range converted to eV (40.9 neV = 4.09e-8 eV, 49.3 neV ≈ 4.93e-8 eV ≈ 5.06e-8 eV midpoint, 54.4 neV ≈ 5.44e-8 eV ≈ 5.67e-8 eV midpoint). The coupling value is uniform across all three ranges at the stated average sensitivity. Local dark matter density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ is explicitly stated in the paper as a standard assumption for ALP dark matter searches.
